design.decision: Bid your full hand and take exactly that many tricks. Late in the round, duck winners on purpose.
design.opponent: Shown on the first exact make. Opponents can feed this team overtricks.
design.rationale: This is the multiplier version: Exact with bid tension. It covers the 'quarter of multipliers scale with contract' target in a minor archetype.
design.draftText: +2 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract if your team makes its contract exactly

critic.concerns: Category-only near-duplicate of cb-exact-trick-points; opponents can feed overtricks, which is good counterplay.
